newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: Indonesia's rubber markets are closed from February 7 to February 11 for the Moslem Eid al-Fitr holiday.
On Thursday, March SIR20 was higher at 53.75-54.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and Surabaya while levels went up at 53.50-53.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang.
Offer prices were quoted at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Padang and at 53.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
The market will open again on February 12.
